requirements.statement: For information that a time-based media gives by shape, size or position, the other means of obtaining it is relevant.

citations.quote: Cette règle est-elle implémentée de façon pertinente ?
pour chaque média temporel, l’information ne doit pas être donnée uniquement par la forme, taille ou position
Retrouver dans le document les informations d’un média temporel données par la forme, la taille ou la position

routes.statement: The other means conveys the information in every context of use and to every user.

citations.quote: vérifier que le moyen alternatif de récupérer cette information est pertinent, c’est-à-dire qu’il permet de transmettre l’information dans tous les contextes de consultation et pour tous les utilisateurs

rationale.text: The test asks whether the other means of obtaining information that a time-based media gives by shape, size or position is relevant. The methodology defines relevant as conveying the information in every context of use and to every user. That needs the information and the other means to be understood, and every context of use to be considered, which is judgment. The same judgment finds the elements the test applies to: the glossary gives three examples of information given by shape, size or position and extends to any similar graphic effect. No axe rule is tagged for this test, and no deterministic check can examine relevance, so no check is linked and the candidate is none. Whether another means exists at all is the question of test 10.9.3, judged there on its own wording. The methodology does not name an assistive technology, so assistive_tech is not listed, although conveying the information to every user may in practice be checked with one. Applicability is judgment: a page may hold a video or audio element whose content gives no information by shape, size or position, and only watching it tells; whether a canvas or svg element is a time-based media is also judgment. Needs is media: the information lies in what the media shows while it plays, so the media must play to be examined. A time-based media offered as a file to download is outside what the tool examines.
